source: Codex re-probe c5 (thread/resume with excludeTurns after unsubscribe), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; modelled as the next server lifetime of a confirmed session

params.prompt: What token did I ask you to remember? Reply with just the token.

expect.notes: A session with a confirmed vendor thread id reopens on a new connection with thread/resume {threadId exact, excludeTurns:true, current sandbox mode}; the returned thread.id equals it, so identity is confirmed for this generation and no thread/start is sent (C2 §2 Reopen; vendors/codex.md §3 Reopen idle session). Turn overrides persist as thread defaults, so turn/start still carries every frozen value.
